day_local: Jumatatu ya Juma la Ishirini na Saba la Mwaka wa Kanisa
greeting: Katika jina la Baba, na la Mwana, na la Roho Mtakatifu. Bwana awe nanyi katika safari hii ya imani na matumaini.
penitential: Bwana, uliyekuja kutuonyesha njia ya kweli, hurumia. Kristo, uliyemwita Ben katika uzima wako wa milele, hurumia. Bwana, uliye tumaini letu pekee katika huzuni, hurumia.
homily:
Fikiria kwa dakika moja picha ya Benjamin Vo akiwa amesimama uwanjani, akitazama ndege ikipaa juu angani. Katika macho yake, ndege ile haikuwa tu chuma na injini; ilikuwa ni uwezekano, ilikuwa ni ndoto, ilikuwa ni ahadi kwamba ulimwengu ni mkubwa na unapaswa kuchunguzwa kwa udadisi. Ben alikuwa kijana mwenye akili ya ajabu, kijana aliyeweza kuandika 'code' za kompyuta na kutatua hesabu za juu, lakini zaidi ya yote, alikuwa kijana aliyekuwa na moyo wa 'con chim airlines'—ndoto ya ndege yake binafsi iliyokuwa ikimfanya atabasamu na kucheka kwa furaha safi. Leo, katika Injili, tunakutana na msomi wa sheria anayemwuliza Yesu, 'Nifanye nini ili nirithi uzima wa milele?' Yesu anamjibu kwa swali, na kisha anamwambia kisa cha Msamaria mwema. Ni kisa cha mtu aliyepigwa, aliyeachwa nusu mfu kando ya barabara, na watu wawili wa dini wakapita upande wa pili. Lakini Msamaria, yule ambaye hakutarajiwa, alisimama. Alimwendea, akamtibu, akamchukua, na akalipia gharama zote. 

Alan na Thao, na wewe Ryan, najua kwamba miezi hii mitatu imekuwa kama safari ndefu katika bonde ambalo mwanga unaonekana kuwa mbali. Najua ukimya wa nyumba wakati wa asubuhi, ule ukimya ambao zamani ulikuwa ukivunjwa na sauti ya Ben akisema 'Good morning, Dad.' Kuna wakati huzuni inakuja kama wimbi, na katika giza hilo, shetani anajaribu kuleta mzigo wa ziada: mzigo wa kujilaumu. Labda umejiuliza, 'Je, ningeweza kufanya zaidi? Je, nilikosa ishara yoyote?' Nataka kusimama hapa leo na kukuambia ukweli huu mbele ya Mungu: Hamkosa kitu. Mungu hajawahi kuwapa mzigo huu kama adhabu. Ugonjwa ule haukutokana na chochote mlichofanya au mlichoshindwa kufanya; ulikuwa nje ya uwezo wa binadamu yeyote. Mungu hawaangalii ninyi kwa jicho la lawama; anaupokea upendo wenu mkuu kama dhabihu safi. Acheni jiwe lile la lawama lianguke chini kabisa. Mlimpenda Ben kwa ukamilifu wote wa roho yenu. Mungu hawashtumu, na ninyi msijilaumu wenyewe kamwe. Ugonjwa si adhabu; ni dhoruba inayokuja bila sababu, na ninyi mlikuwa wazazi waaminifu, walezi bora, na mashahidi wa upendo wa kweli. 

Katika Injili, Msamaria anaguswa na huruma. Hii ndiyo siri ya maisha ya Ben. Kumbukeni ule ukarimu wa ajabu wa Ben. Wakati mjomba wake William alipokuwa akisumbuliwa na maradhi ya kiharusi, Ben, akiwa na miaka kumi na tano tu na bila kuombwa na mtu yeyote, aliwaambia wazazi wake kwamba alikuwa tayari kutoa akiba yake yote ya piggy bank ili kumsaidia. Hakuivunja, haikuwahi kuvunjwa kwa sababu haikuhitajika, lakini ofa ile—uamuzi wa kijana wa miaka kumi na tano kusema 'chukueni vyote'—ndiyo dhabihu safi mbele ya Mungu. Hiyo ndiyo roho ya Ben. Alikuwa kijana aliyekuwa tayari kutoa kila kitu kwa ajili ya upendo. Hii ndiyo siri ya maisha ambayo hayawi 'ubatili'. Maisha yanayotolewa kwa wengine hayapotei. Yanaingia katika uzima wa milele. 

Ryan, kaka mdogo wa Ben, najua unamkumbuka kaka yako. Najua unakumbuka zile nyakati za kucheza pamoja na zile safari za ndege. Usiogope kuhisi upweke, lakini pia usiogope kuendelea kuishi. Ben anakuangalia. Yeye anataka uwe na furaha, anataka uendelee kuota ndoto kubwa, na anataka ujue kwamba upendo wenu kama ndugu hauwezi kufutwa na kifo. Kila hatua unayopiga mbele ni sehemu ya kuendeleza urithi wa upendo ambao Ben aliacha hapa duniani. Unapomkumbuka, usiweke huzuni tu; weka shukrani kwa sababu ulikuwa na kaka kama yeye. 

Ndugu zangu wote mnaosikiliza, hasa familia zinazobeba misigo mizito: Mungu yuko pamoja nanyi. Mtume Paulo anatuambia katika Waraka wake kwa Wagalatia kwamba Injili aliyoipokea imekuja kwa ufunuo wa Yesu Kristo. Hii si hekima ya wanadamu, bali ni nguvu ya Mungu. Ben sasa yuko katika ule 'Banquet ya Mbinguni' ambapo ndege zote zinatua salama, ambapo hakuna maumivu, na ambapo kila 'code' ya maisha yake imekamilika mbele ya Mungu. Kumbukumbu yake inabaki hai kupitia kila tendo la wema linalofanyika kwa siri kwa jina lake—iwe ni kisima kile cha maji kule Cà Mau kinachotoa uhai kwa watu wasiomjua Ben, lakini wanaonufaika na upendo wake. 

Basi, tunapomaliza tafakari hii, tuchukue jambo hili moja mioyoni mwetu: Upendo haufi kamwe. Kila kumbukumbu njema ya Benjamin Vo, kila tabasamu lake, na kila wema wake unabaki kuwa taa inayowaongoza wazazi wake na wote waliompendaje. Simameni imara, msiogope, na mtembee kwa matumaini makuu, mkijua kwamba siku moja tutakutana naye tena katika nuru ile isiyozimika ya milele. Mungu awabariki na kuwalinda sasa na hata milele. Amina.
spiritual_communion: Yesu wangu, ninaamini ya kuwa upo katika Sakramenti Takatifu. Nakupenda kuliko vitu vyote, nami natamani kukupokea katika nafsi yangu. Kwa kuwa siwezi sasa kukupokea katika Sakramenti, uje ndani ya moyo wangu kiroho. Nakuumbatia kama vile ulishakuja, nami ninaunganisha nafsi yangu yote nawe. Usiniache kamwe nitengane nawe. Amina.
closing: Bwana awabariki, awatunze, na awajalie amani yake inayopita akili zote. Amina.
standing_petitions: Kwa ajili ya Ben na wote waliofariki, ili wapumzike katika nuru ya milele ya Kristo.
Kwa ajili ya wote wanaoomboleza, ili Mungu awafariji na kuwapa matumaini mapya.

readings.label: Somo la kwanza
readings.text: Nastaajabu ya kuwa mnamwacha upesi hivi yeye aliyewaita katika neema ya Kristo, na kugeukia injili nyingine; si kwamba kuna injili nyingine; lakini wapo watu wawachafuao, watakao kuigeuza injili ya Kristo. Lakini hata sisi, au malaika wa mbinguni akiwahubiri injili yoyote isipokuwa ile tuliyowahubiri, na alaaniwe! Kama tulivyotangulia kusema, na sasa nasema tena, mtu yeyote akiwahubiri injili yoyote isipokuwa ile mliyopokea, na alaaniwe! Je! Nataka kuvuta ridhaa ya wanadamu au ya Mungu? Au natafuta kuwapendeza wanadamu? Kama ningekuwa nikijaribu kuwapendeza wanadamu, singekuwa mtumwa wa Kristo. Nawaarifu, ndugu zangu, ya kuwa injili iliyohubiriwa na mimi siyo ya kibinadamu. Kwa maana sikuipokea kwa mwanadamu, wala sikufundishwa na mwanadamu, bali kwa ufunuo wa Yesu Kristo.

readings.label: Zaburi ya kuitikiana
readings.text: Nitashukuru kwa moyo wangu wote, katika kusanyiko la wenye haki. Matendo ya Bwana ni makuu, hutafutwa na wote wapendezwao nayo. Matendo ya mikono yake ni kweli na hukumu, maagizo yake yote ni amini. Yamesimamishwa milele na milele, yamefanywa katika kweli na adili. Amewapelekea watu wake ukombozi, ameliagiza agano lake milele; jina lake ni takatifu na la kuogopwa. Sifa zake zadumu milele.

readings.label: Injili
readings.text: Na tazama, mwalimu mmoja wa sheria alisimama akamjaribu, akisema, Mwalimu, nifanye nini ili nirithi uzima wa milele? Akamwambia, Imeandikwa nini katika torati? Wasomaje? Akajibu akasema, Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, na kwa roho yako yote, na kwa nguvu zako zote, na kwa akili zako zote; na jirani yako kama nafsi yako. Akamwambia, Umejibu vema; fanya hivi, nawe utaishi. Naye akitaka kujijulia haki, akamwambia Yesu, Na jirani yangu ni nani? Yesu akajibu akasema, Mtu mmoja alishuka kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Yeriko, akaangukia mikononi mwa wanyang'anyi, wakamvua nguo, wakampiga, wakaondoka wakamwacha nusu mfu. Kwa bahati kuhani mmoja akashuka njia ile; na alipomwona, akapita kando. Na Mlawi vivyo hivyo, akafika mahali pale, akamwona, akapita kando. Lakini Msamaria mmoja, akisafiri, akafika karibu naye, na alipomwona akaona huruma, akamwendea, akamfunga jeraha zake, akizitia mafuta na divai; akampandisha juu ya mnyama wake, akampeleka nyumba ya wageni, akamtunza. Hata siku ya pili akatoa dinari mbili, akampa mwenye nyumba, akasema, Mtunze huyu; na chochote utakachogharimia zaidi, nitakulipa nitakaporudi. Basi, katika hao watatu, ni yupi, katika kuona kwako, aliyekuwa jirani yake yule aliyeangukia mikononi mwa wanyang'anyi? Akasema, Ni yule aliyemwonea huruma. Yesu akamwambia, Enenda zako, nawe fanya vivyo hivyo.

day: Monday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.
